subject: SIG request: Nebula Finance onboarding - ownership and next steps
messages:
From: Ellie Park <ellie.park@nebula-finance.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@nebula-finance.com
Date: 2026-06-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SIG request: Nebula Finance onboarding

Hi Irene,

We're kicking off procurement for Redwood and they asked for a completed SIG questionnaire and a list of evidence artifacts to attach. I've attached Nebula's intake form (PDF) with priority sections flagged — legal, encryption, vendor mgmt. Can you confirm whether you need any additional info from our side?

Target timeline from our procurement team: they want the returned SIG in two weeks (by 2026-07-09). If that timeline won't work, let us know earliest possible date.

Attachments: [Nebula_SIG_Request.pdf (pdf)]

Thanks,
Ellie Park
Senior IT Sourcing, Nebula Finance
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-25T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: SIG request: Nebula Finance onboarding - ownership and next steps

Team — forwarding a new SIG intake from Nebula (attached). Ellie flagged legal, encryption, and vendor mgmt as high priority. Can we do a quick ownership pass so I can get back with an ETA? Proposed split below based on last SIG playbook:

- Legal / Contracts: Lauren
- Encryption / KMS: Vivek
- Vendor management / Third-party: Neha
- Remaining sections (networking, IAM, logging): I'll coordinate with Infra leads after owners are confirmed.

Please reply with: 1) confirm/decline ownership, 2) any blockers for providing evidence (doc access, gating approvals), and 3) quick ETA (days). I will collate and reply to Ellie with a timeline.

Attachment: [Nebula_SIG_Request.pdf], Add'l: "initial_evidence_index.csv" (I started a spreadsheet in Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-nebula-sig-evidence)

Thanks — Irene
Irene Choi
Head of Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-25T13:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: SIG request: Nebula Finance onboarding - ownership and next steps

Confirming I'll take Vendor management / Third-party controls. Quick notes:
- I have the current vendor roster and our recent due-diligence package ready in Drive (linked in the sheet).
- For a couple of third-party questionnaires we may need signed data flow diagrams from Product; I've flagged that in the evidence index.
- ETA: I can assemble evidence and initial responses in 3 business days (by 2026-06-30) pending Product signoffs.

If Lauren or Vivek see any overlap (e.g., vendors that handle keys), call it out and I'll coordinate the crosswalk.

-Neha
Senior Manager, Security Programs
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-26T08:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: SIG request: Nebula Finance onboarding - ownership and next steps

I'll own Encryption / KMS. Couple of practicals:
- We store KMS rotation logs and key access matrices in the secure audit bucket; I'll export the redacted logs and an access matrix CSV.
- Possible blocker: if Nebula wants raw audit logs (unlikely), we'll need an NDA addendum — otherwise redacted exports should be fine.
- ETA: initial responses + artifacts available by EOD 2026-07-01.

Linking the evidence folder here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-nebula-sig-evidence (I added a subfolder /encryption)

-Vivek
Director, Infrastructure Security
From: Ellie Park <ellie.park@nebula-finance.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@nebula-finance.com
Date: 2026-06-29T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG request: Nebula Finance onboarding - ownership and next steps

Hi Irene — thanks for the quick routing and team responses. Procurement asked for a one-line ETA to include in their tracker. Based on replies below, can you confirm a committed date when Redwood will return the completed SIG + evidence bundle? If we get it by 2026-07-02 that keeps us on schedule; otherwise they want realistic expectations for the vendor committee.

Appreciate it — Ellie
